projectName: Konzerte in der Petruskirche / Kieler Konzertkirche
description: Static Astro/React/Vite+ website for concerts at Petruskirche Kiel, deployed as Cloudflare Workers static assets. Current implementation is guided by rich design references in concepts/ and Stitch exports for a polished Konzertkirche experience.

goals.description: Implement a polished multi-page Konzertkirche website from Stitch exports and existing concept prototypes.
Keep the site static, fast, accessible, responsive, and verified through Vite+ checks, Astro build, and manual responsive/accessibility review.
Maintain Linear/GitHub workflow with feature branches, PR review, and Cloudflare-ready build artifacts.

buildTools: Vite+ command surface for install/dev/check/run workflows
Vite+ check via Oxfmt, Oxlint, and TypeScript/tsgo
Astro CLI and @astrojs/check for static site builds
Husky configured through Vite+ hooks/staged settings
Wrangler configuration for Cloudflare static asset deployment
packageManagers: Vite+ is the canonical project workflow: use vp install, vp run dev, vp check, vp run build, and vp run quality.
Vite+ delegates dependency installation to the package-manager backend detected from package.json/lockfiles; bun.lock is currently committed for reproducible delegated installs.
Use npx/npm only for isolated external tooling such as shadcn or CI-only Babysitter SDK installation.
infrastructure: Cloudflare Workers static assets configured by wrangler.toml with dist as asset directory.
GitHub Actions CI uses voidzero-dev/setup-vp and runs the canonical Vite+ quality gate.
Devcontainer is based on Jetpack Devbox; project workflow should still be executed through Vite+.
Vite+ staged configuration in vite.config.ts governs pre-commit formatting/linting.
Linear is the project-management source of truth per AGENTS.md and .agents/linear-workflow.md.

architecture.pattern: Static Astro landing page using file-based routing, a shared Astro layout, Tailwind CSS global styling, and optional React islands for client-side interactivity. The current production source is a minimal scaffold/prototype rather than a full multi-section implementation.

modules.name: pages
modules.summary: Astro file-based routes. Currently only src/pages/index.astro defines the homepage.

modules.name: layouts
modules.summary: Base HTML document wrapper. Layout.astro imports global CSS, sets German language metadata, viewport, description, favicon, generator, and title.

modules.name: components/ui
modules.summary: Reusable UI/island components. Currently contains a sample React Counter.tsx component hydrated with client:load. Project instructions say shadcn/ui generated files belong here and should not be edited directly.

modules.name: lib
modules.summary: Shared utilities. utils.ts exports cn(), combining clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional Tailwind class names.

modules.name: styles
modules.summary: Global CSS. globals.css imports Tailwind CSS v4.

modules.name: concepts
modules.summary: Standalone HTML/CSS/JS concept prototypes and assets based on Mobbin references. These are not wired into the Astro app.

modules.name: stitch exports
modules.summary: Exported design/reference screens and HTML for Kieler Konzertkirche pages, with manifest metadata. Not wired into runtime source.

modules.name: assets
modules.summary: Large source media library for Petruskirche interior and exterior imagery, outside Astro src/public asset pipeline in current code.

dataFlow: Astro resolves file-based routes from src/pages; / maps to src/pages/index.astro.
index.astro imports Layout.astro and Counter.tsx, renders static markup for the landing page, and requests client-side hydration for Counter via client:load.
Layout.astro imports src/styles/globals.css once and wraps page content through <slot /> while injecting metadata and title props.
Tailwind CSS utilities are authored directly in Astro/TSX markup; globals.css imports Tailwind v4.
Counter.tsx owns local React state only; there is no remote data fetching, persistence, API layer, CMS, or server-side runtime state.
Build flow is astro check followed by astro build, outputting static assets to dist for Cloudflare Workers static asset serving.

naming.pages: Astro file-based route names such as index.astro and about.astro

git.branching: Create feature branches from main using Linear ticket IDs.
git.commits: Reference ticket IDs in commit messages; .agents/linear-workflow.md uses AKG-XXX: message while README shows KON-123 as an example.
git.pullRequests: Use GitHub PR template, link Linear ticket, and include local dev, responsive, accessibility, lint, and build checks.
git.codeowners: @zepi2509 owns repository-wide changes plus source, styles, config, workflows, and documentation.

codeStyle.typescript: Strict TypeScript; no explicit any; unused args may be prefixed with underscore.
codeStyle.react: Functional components with hooks; React 19 automatic JSX runtime; react/prop-types disabled.
codeStyle.astro: Use Astro Islands only for interactive components; avoid astro:set:html via astro/no-set-html-directive.
codeStyle.tailwind: Prefer Tailwind utility classes; extract repeated patterns into reusable components; class sorting is handled by Vite+ formatting.
codeStyle.formatting: 2-space indentation, semicolons, single quotes, print width 100, no trailing commas per .prettierrc.
codeStyle.comments: Add comments for complex logic only.

importOrder: No explicit import-order rule is configured.
Observed style places external package imports before local imports in TS files, and local Astro imports in frontmatter.
Path alias @/* maps to ./src/* and shadcn aliases map components, ui, lib, utils, and hooks.
errorHandling: Static app currently has no centralized error boundary or runtime error-handling abstraction.
Vite+ linting warns on console usage except console.warn and console.error.
Build pipeline relies on Vite+ checks, Astro check/build, and CI to catch errors before deployment.
Do not add server-side features or API behavior because deployment target is static Cloudflare Workers assets.
testingConventions: No unit, integration, or e2e test framework is currently configured.
CI and handoff quality gates use vp run quality: Vite+ static checks, context audit, and Astro production build.
Context drift is checked by vp run context:check using context.config.json and scripts/context-audit.mjs.
PR/handoff notes should include manual verification for local dev, responsive behavior, accessibility, and build output.
Add a dedicated test command once interactive behavior grows beyond static checks.
additionalRules: Use Vite+ commands: vp install, vp run dev, vp check ., vp run build, vp run quality.
Do not directly modify generated/vendor shadcn/ui components unless intentional; add components through the shadcn CLI.
Do not add server-side features or API behavior because the deployment target is static Cloudflare Workers assets.
Do not commit sensitive data or environment secrets.

claudeMdInstructions: Use the Vite+ command surface for normal project workflow; avoid direct package-manager commands unless debugging that layer.
Follow AGENTS.md for startup rules and load task-specific context files only when relevant.
Run vp run context:check after changing context-management files; vp run quality includes this audit.
Use Stitch exports in stitch-exports/kieler-konzertkirche and concepts/website-mvps as design references for implementation.
Load standards/design-foundation-research.md only for foundation-level design, token, component-system, or major redesign decisions.
For UI/page/component work, read DESIGN.md and standards/interface-craft.md before handoff.
Before PR or handoff after code changes, run vp run quality; include manual responsive/accessibility notes for UI changes.
Preserve static Cloudflare Workers deployment assumptions unless explicitly asked to add server-side behavior.
Babysitter PR checks live in .github/workflows/babysitter.yml; enable full orchestration only after setting BABYSITTER_CI_ENABLED and a CI-compatible BABYSITTER_HARNESS.
